issues.description: Constructor visibility inconsistency for class Lecture: the solution implementation declares the constructor with package-private visibility (signature "Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors)") in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java (line 13). The problem statement instructs students to "Create a constructor that initializes every attribute" (problem_statement.md lines 19-21) but does not specify visibility, and the template contains a TODO placeholder for adding the constructor (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 6). Because the rest of the public API (getters/setters and other methods) is public in the solution, the package-private constructor may confuse students or test harnesses that expect an explicitly public constructor and could block instantiation from other packages. Clarify the intended visibility or make the constructor explicitly public.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the intended visibility explicit. Either change the solution constructor to be public (declare "public Lecture(...)") and update the template example/TODO to show a public constructor, or update the problem statement to state that a package-private constructor is acceptable and tests will instantiate within the same package. Prefer making the constructor explicitly public to avoid cross-package instantiation issues.
